3.name: Divination Savant
3.notes:
Add two free level 1–2 Divination Wizard spells to your spellbook.
Whenever you gain a new level of spell slots, add one free Divination spell of a level you can cast.

3.name: Portent
3.notes:
After each Long Rest, roll two d20s and record the results.
You may replace any D20 Test (yours or a creature you can see) with one of these rolls, chosen before the roll.
Each foretelling roll can be used once; unused rolls vanish when you finish a Long Rest.
You may replace only one roll per turn.

6.name: Expert Divination
6.notes:
When you cast a Divination spell using a level 2+ spell slot, regain one expended spell slot.
The regained slot must be lower level than the one spent and no higher than level 5.

10.name: The Third Eye
10.notes:
Bonus Action; choose one benefit until you start a Short or Long Rest. Usable once per Short or Long Rest.
• Darkvision: 120 ft.
• Greater Comprehension: Read all languages.
• See Invisibility: Cast See Invisibility without using a spell slot.

14.name: Greater Portent
14.notes: You now roll three d20s for Portent instead of two after each Long Rest.
